in_sanskrit.name: Bijender
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror of Bija (Seeds)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bijender एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bijender is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bij' meaning seed and 'andh' meaning to conquer. This name is given to a boy who is believed to have the power to conquer and grow new things, like a seed that sprouts and becomes a plant. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often depicted as the one who plants the seeds of creation and nurtures them into existence.
